channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Mbappe blames technical, tactical blunders for World Cup semifinal loss
item.description: France striker admits Spain controlled the game and made them pay for errors in the semifinal in Dallas.

item.title: US star Balogun knew red card reversal would ‘cause a lot of controversy’
item.description: Striker says FIFA's decision to suspend his one-match ban led to 'a lot of outside noise' before USA's knockout match.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says strikes ‘will continue until I say enough’
item.description: Iran's bridges, power plants possible targets, Trump said as IRGC says it attacked US forces in Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan.

item.title: Sirens blare in Bahrain as Iran launches barrage of missiles, drones
item.description: Iranian state media is reporting that Tehran has targeted a US naval support base in Bahrain’s capital.

item.title: What is Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain?
item.description: Donald Trump has threatened to strike Pickaxe Mountain, an underground nuclear-related complex.

item.title: Worker killed in furnace explosion fire at Indian recycling plant
item.description: A furnace explosion triggered a fire at Jain Resource Recycling's plant in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.

item.title: US Senate Democrats block defence bill over Iran war, Israel integration
item.description: The Senate votes 50-46 to block debate on the annual defence bill over war funding and defence cooperation with Israel.

item.title: US reimposes blockade on Iranian ports, launches more strikes
item.description: Iran's deputy FM accuses US of destroying the interim peace deal and says Tehran now has no commitments under MoU.

item.title: Trump scraps threat of 20% fee on Hormuz cargo as US resumes blockade of Iran ports
item.description: Trump drops a 24-hour-old vow to charge cargo ships for using the Strait as the US continues its battle to break Iran's hold on the waterway.

item.title: Trump retreat over Hormuz tolls suggests he is struggling to end Iran war
item.description: The abrupt about-face from the US president was the latest twist in a conflict that has now lasted more than four months.
